_readme: Everything the site says about the shop lives here. Edit this file, run `npm run build`, and every page updates. Nothing else needs touching for day-to-day changes (phone, hours, prices, team, reviews).
name: Escape Barbershop
tagline: Where a cut becomes an escape
description: Escape Barbershop in Mivida, New Cairo — fades, beard sculpting, hot-towel shaves and grooming packages, by appointment or walk-in.
_hours: One row per weekday, starting Sunday. Set open/close to null for a closed day. 24-hour clock.
_services: The shop's real menu, taken from the POS. `price` is null until you fill it in — while every price is null the site simply shows durations instead of an empty price column. `featured` services appear on the home page.

_photoCaptions: Optional alt text for photos dropped into images/gallery/, keyed by their path under that folder. Anything not listed gets a caption made from its file name.
_reviews: Real customer reviews only. Leave the list empty and the Reviews page invites people to Google instead of showing anything made up. Add entries as { "quote", "author", "source", "rating" }.

faq.a: No — walk-ins are welcome and always have been. But evenings and weekends fill up, so booking ahead is the difference between sitting straight down and waiting for a chair.
Use the booking form on this site and it sends your request straight to the shop on WhatsApp, or just call us. You'll get a reply confirming the time.

faq.q: How long does a visit take?
faq.a: A cut is about 30 minutes and a beard around 20. Colour, protein and straightening run from 45 minutes up to two hours — the full menu lists the time for every service.
Ask us for the current price list — prices move with product costs, so we'd rather quote you than publish something out of date.
Yes. Kids' cuts are on the menu and the barbers are patient with first-timers.

faq.q: Which payment methods do you take?
faq.a: Cash and card, plus the usual mobile wallets.
Yes — there are two groom packages, one in the shop and one where a barber comes to you on the day. See the Offers page.
Eterna Mall, Gate 2, in Mivida, New Cairo. The Visit page has a map and directions.
Yes, there's parking at the mall right by Gate 2.

faq.q: Can I book a specific barber?
faq.a: Of course. Pick them on the booking form, or name them when you call — regulars usually do.
